meta.title: Contradiction Ledger — Living Document
meta.source: APEX ART probe of VPS state
meta.principle: Max 3 active contradictions at any time
meta.closure_rule: A contradiction is CLOSED only when a falsifiable receipt proves the gap reduced

contradictions.name: Verification > Execution
contradictions.compressed: Scripts exist but don't run autonomously — verification debt accumulates

evidence.gap: 80% of verification scripts exist but are not automated
evidence.pattern: Discover → build script → never schedule → drift re-accumulates

contradictions.closure_test: What evidence shows decision cycles shortened? (e.g., audit scripts auto-running, findings auto-resolved without manual trigger)
contradictions.proposed_action: Convert top 5 audit scripts into scheduled cron jobs with auto-deliver on contradiction found
contradictions.receipt_required: Cron execution log showing N audits completed + 0 manual triggers needed

contradictions.name: Doctrine ≠ Runtime
contradictions.compressed: Declared topology drifts from live state — governance on stale maps

evidence.gap: Doc-declared topology not continuously reconciled with live ss -tlnp
evidence.pattern: Docs updated → containers restart/move → drift silent → decisions on stale map

contradictions.closure_test: What evidence shows drift reduced? (e.g., drift detection auto-corrects or flags within 1 hour of change)
contradictions.proposed_action: Schedule hourly drift probe: compare AAA_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY.yaml declared ports vs ss -tlnp live ports
contradictions.receipt_required: Drift report showing 0 mismatches over 7 consecutive days

contradictions.name: Capability > Attention
contradictions.compressed: All 332 skills treated equally alive — no dormancy classification

evidence.gap: No dormancy classification — all 332 treated as equally alive
evidence.pattern: New skill added → never classified → becomes maintenance debt

contradictions.closure_test: What evidence shows fewer priorities active? (e.g., skill count classified: <50 Alive, rest Archived/Dormant/Constitutional)
contradictions.proposed_action: Run dormancy classification on all 332 skills → bucket into Alive/Dormant/Constitutional/Vanity → prune Vanity
contradictions.receipt_required: Classification report + Arif ratification of buckets

selection_function.rule: Only 3 contradictions active at any time
selection_function.promotion: A new contradiction enters only when one of the 3 is CLOSED or explicitly demoted
selection_function.demotion: Contradictions that cannot be closed within 30 days move to SCAR (pattern recorded, not actively tracked)
selection_function.monthly_scan: Auto-scan on 1st of month — probe all surfaces, compare against these 3, deliver 1-page verdict
